005package org.wpilib.math.controller;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.trajectory.TrapezoidProfile;
008import org.wpilib.math.util.MathUtil;
009import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
010import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
011import org.wpilib.tunable.ComplexTunable;
012import org.wpilib.tunable.TunableConfig;
013import org.wpilib.tunable.TunableOption;
014import org.wpilib.tunable.TunableTable;
015import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
016
017/**
018 * Implements a PID control loop whose setpoint is constrained by a trapezoid profile. Users should
019 * call reset() when they first start running the controller to avoid unwanted behavior.
020 */
021public class ProfiledPIDController implements TelemetryLoggable, ComplexTunable {
022  private static int instances;
023
024  private PIDController m_controller;
025  private double m_minimumInput;
026  private double m_maximumInput;
027
028  private TrapezoidProfile.Constraints m_constraints;
029  private TrapezoidProfile m_profile;
030  private TrapezoidProfile.State m_goal = new TrapezoidProfile.State();
031  private TrapezoidProfile.State m_setpoint = new TrapezoidProfile.State();
032
033  /**
034   * Allocates a ProfiledPIDController with the given constants for Kp, Ki, and Kd.
035   *
036   * @param Kp The proportional coefficient.
037   * @param Ki The integral coefficient.
038   * @param Kd The derivative coefficient.
039   * @param constraints Velocity and acceleration constraints for goal.
040   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if kp &lt; 0
041   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if ki &lt; 0
042   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if kd &lt; 0
043   */
044  public ProfiledPIDController(
045      double Kp, double Ki, double Kd, TrapezoidProfile.Constraints constraints) {
046    this(Kp, Ki, Kd, constraints, 0.02);
047  }
048
049  /**
050   * Allocates a ProfiledPIDController with the given constants for Kp, Ki, and Kd.
051   *
052   * @param Kp The proportional coefficient.
053   * @param Ki The integral coefficient.
054   * @param Kd The derivative coefficient.
055   * @param constraints Velocity and acceleration constraints for goal.
056   * @param period The period between controller updates in seconds. The default is 0.02 seconds.
057   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if kp &lt; 0
058   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if ki &lt; 0
059   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if kd &lt; 0
060   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if period &lt;= 0
061   */
062  @SuppressWarnings("this-escape")
063  public ProfiledPIDController(
064      double Kp, double Ki, double Kd, TrapezoidProfile.Constraints constraints, double period) {
065    m_controller = new PIDController(Kp, Ki, Kd, period);
066    m_constraints = constraints;
067    m_profile = new TrapezoidProfile(m_constraints);
068    instances++;
069
070    UsageReporting.reportUsage("ProfiledPIDController", String.valueOf(instances));
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Sets the PID Controller gain parameters.
075   *
076   * <p>Sets the proportional, integral, and differential coefficients.
077   *
078   * <p>This setter is intended for online tuning.
079   *
080   * @param Kp The proportional coefficient. Must be &gt;= 0.
081   * @param Ki The integral coefficient. Must be &gt;= 0.
082   * @param Kd The differential coefficient. Must be &gt;= 0.
083   */
084  public void setPID(double Kp, double Ki, double Kd) {
085    m_controller.setPID(Kp, Ki, Kd);
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * Sets the proportional coefficient of the PID controller gain.
090   *
091   * <p>This setter is intended for online tuning.
092   *
093   * @param Kp The proportional coefficient. Must be &gt;= 0.
094   */
095  public void setP(double Kp) {
096    m_controller.setP(Kp);
097  }
098
099  /**
100   * Sets the integral coefficient of the PID controller gain.
101   *
102   * <p>This setter is intended for online tuning.
103   *
104   * @param Ki The integral coefficient. Must be &gt;= 0.
105   */
106  public void setI(double Ki) {
107    m_controller.setI(Ki);
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Sets the differential coefficient of the PID controller gain.
112   *
113   * <p>This setter is intended for online tuning.
114   *
115   * @param Kd The differential coefficient. Must be &gt;= 0.
116   */
117  public void setD(double Kd) {
118    m_controller.setD(Kd);
119  }
120
121  /**
122   * Sets the IZone range. When the absolute value of the position error is greater than IZone, the
123   * total accumulated error will reset to zero, disabling integral gain until the absolute value of
124   * the position error is less than IZone. This is used to prevent integral windup. Must be
125   * non-negative. Passing a value of zero will effectively disable integral gain. Passing a value
126   * of {@link Double#POSITIVE_INFINITY} disables IZone functionality.
127   *
128   * @param iZone Maximum magnitude of error to allow integral control.
129   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if iZone &lt;= 0
130   */
131  public void setIZone(double iZone) {
132    m_controller.setIZone(iZone);
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * Gets the proportional coefficient.
137   *
138   * @return proportional coefficient
139   */
140  public double getP() {
141    return m_controller.getP();
142  }
143
144  /**
145   * Gets the integral coefficient.
146   *
147   * @return integral coefficient
148   */
149  public double getI() {
150    return m_controller.getI();
151  }
152
153  /**
154   * Gets the differential coefficient.
155   *
156   * @return differential coefficient
157   */
158  public double getD() {
159    return m_controller.getD();
160  }
161
162  /**
163   * Get the IZone range.
164   *
165   * @return Maximum magnitude of error to allow integral control.
166   */
167  public double getIZone() {
168    return m_controller.getIZone();
169  }
170
171  /**
172   * Gets the period of this controller.
173   *
174   * @return The period of the controller.
175   */
176  public double getPeriod() {
177    return m_controller.getPeriod();
178  }
179
180  /**
181   * Returns the position tolerance of this controller.
182   *
183   * @return the position tolerance of the controller.
184   */
185  public double getPositionTolerance() {
186    return m_controller.getErrorTolerance();
187  }
188
189  /**
190   * Returns the velocity tolerance of this controller.
191   *
192   * @return the velocity tolerance of the controller.
193   */
194  public double getVelocityTolerance() {
195    return m_controller.getErrorDerivativeTolerance();
196  }
197
198  /**
199   * Returns the accumulated error used in the integral calculation of this controller.
200   *
201   * @return The accumulated error of this controller.
202   */
203  public double getAccumulatedError() {
204    return m_controller.getAccumulatedError();
205  }
206
207  /**
208   * Sets the goal for the ProfiledPIDController.
209   *
210   * @param goal The desired goal state.
211   */
212  public void setGoal(TrapezoidProfile.State goal) {
213    if (m_goal.position != goal.position) {
214      setChildTunableChanged("goal");
215    }
216    m_goal = goal;
217  }
218
219  /**
220   * Sets the goal for the ProfiledPIDController.
221   *
222   * @param goal The desired goal position.
223   */
224  public void setGoal(double goal) {
225    setGoal(new TrapezoidProfile.State(goal, 0));
226  }
227
228  /**
229   * Gets the goal for the ProfiledPIDController.
230   *
231   * @return The goal.
232   */
233  public TrapezoidProfile.State getGoal() {
234    return m_goal;
235  }
236
237  /**
238   * Returns true if the error is within the tolerance of the error.
239   *
240   * <p>This will return false until at least one input value has been computed.
241   *
242   * @return True if the error is within the tolerance of the error.
243   */
244  public boolean atGoal() {
245    return atSetpoint() && m_goal.equals(m_setpoint);
246  }
247
248  /**
249   * Set velocity and acceleration constraints for goal.
250   *
251   * @param constraints Velocity and acceleration constraints for goal.
252   */
253  public void setConstraints(TrapezoidProfile.Constraints constraints) {
254    m_constraints = constraints;
255    m_profile = new TrapezoidProfile(m_constraints);
256    setChildTunableChanged("constraints");
257  }
258
259  /**
260   * Get the velocity and acceleration constraints for this controller.
261   *
262   * @return Velocity and acceleration constraints.
263   */
264  public TrapezoidProfile.Constraints getConstraints() {
265    return m_constraints;
266  }
267
268  /**
269   * Returns the current setpoint of the ProfiledPIDController.
270   *
271   * @return The current setpoint.
272   */
273  public TrapezoidProfile.State getSetpoint() {
274    return m_setpoint;
275  }
276
277  /**
278   * Returns true if the error is within the tolerance of the error.
279   *
280   * <p>This will return false until at least one input value has been computed.
281   *
282   * @return True if the error is within the tolerance of the error.
283   */
284  public boolean atSetpoint() {
285    return m_controller.atSetpoint();
286  }
287
288  /**
289   * Enables continuous input.
290   *
291   * <p>Rather then using the max and min input range as constraints, it considers them to be the
292   * same point and automatically calculates the shortest route to the setpoint.
293   *
294   * @param minimumInput The minimum value expected from the input.
295   * @param maximumInput The maximum value expected from the input.
296   */
297  public void enableContinuousInput(double minimumInput, double maximumInput) {
298    m_controller.enableContinuousInput(minimumInput, maximumInput);
299    m_minimumInput = minimumInput;
300    m_maximumInput = maximumInput;
301  }
302
303  /** Disables continuous input. */
304  public void disableContinuousInput() {
305    m_controller.disableContinuousInput();
306  }
307
308  /**
309   * Sets the minimum and maximum contributions of the integral term.
310   *
311   * <p>The internal integrator is clamped so that the integral term's contribution to the output
312   * stays between minimumIntegral and maximumIntegral. This prevents integral windup.
313   *
314   * @param minimumIntegral The minimum contribution of the integral term.
315   * @param maximumIntegral The maximum contribution of the integral term.
316   */
317  public void setIntegratorRange(double minimumIntegral, double maximumIntegral) {
318    m_controller.setIntegratorRange(minimumIntegral, maximumIntegral);
319  }
320
321  /**
322   * Sets the error which is considered tolerable for use with atSetpoint().
323   *
324   * @param positionTolerance Position error which is tolerable.
325   */
326  public void setTolerance(double positionTolerance) {
327    setTolerance(positionTolerance, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
328  }
329
330  /**
331   * Sets the error which is considered tolerable for use with atSetpoint().
332   *
333   * @param positionTolerance Position error which is tolerable.
334   * @param velocityTolerance Velocity error which is tolerable.
335   */
336  public void setTolerance(double positionTolerance, double velocityTolerance) {
337    m_controller.setTolerance(positionTolerance, velocityTolerance);
338  }
339
340  /**
341   * Returns the difference between the setpoint and the measurement.
342   *
343   * @return The error.
344   */
345  public double getPositionError() {
346    return m_controller.getError();
347  }
348
349  /**
350   * Returns the change in error per second.
351   *
352   * @return The change in error per second.
353   */
354  public double getVelocityError() {
355    return m_controller.getErrorDerivative();
356  }
357
358  /**
359   * Returns the next output of the PID controller.
360   *
361   * @param measurement The current measurement of the process variable.
362   * @return The controller's next output.
363   */
364  public double calculate(double measurement) {
365    if (m_controller.isContinuousInputEnabled()) {
366      // Get error which is the smallest distance between goal and measurement
367      double errorBound = (m_maximumInput - m_minimumInput) / 2.0;
368      double goalMinDistance =
369          MathUtil.inputModulus(m_goal.position - measurement, -errorBound, errorBound);
370      double setpointMinDistance =
371          MathUtil.inputModulus(m_setpoint.position - measurement, -errorBound, errorBound);
372
373      // Recompute the profile goal with the smallest error, thus giving the shortest path. The goal
374      // may be outside the input range after this operation, but that's OK because the controller
375      // will still go there and report an error of zero. In other words, the setpoint only needs to
376      // be offset from the measurement by the input range modulus; they don't need to be equal.
377      double goalPosition = goalMinDistance + measurement;
378      if (Double.compare(m_goal.position, goalPosition) != 0) {
379        setChildTunableChanged("goal");
380      }
381      m_goal.position = goalPosition;
382      m_setpoint.position = setpointMinDistance + measurement;
383    }
384
385    m_setpoint = m_profile.calculate(getPeriod(), m_setpoint, m_goal);
386    return m_controller.calculate(measurement, m_setpoint.position);
387  }
388
389  /**
390   * Returns the next output of the PID controller.
391   *
392   * @param measurement The current measurement of the process variable.
393   * @param goal The new goal of the controller.
394   * @return The controller's next output.
395   */
396  public double calculate(double measurement, TrapezoidProfile.State goal) {
397    setGoal(goal);
398    return calculate(measurement);
399  }
400
401  /**
402   * Returns the next output of the PIDController.
403   *
404   * @param measurement The current measurement of the process variable.
405   * @param goal The new goal of the controller.
406   * @return The controller's next output.
407   */
408  public double calculate(double measurement, double goal) {
409    setGoal(goal);
410    return calculate(measurement);
411  }
412
413  /**
414   * Returns the next output of the PID controller.
415   *
416   * @param measurement The current measurement of the process variable.
417   * @param goal The new goal of the controller.
418   * @param constraints Velocity and acceleration constraints for goal.
419   * @return The controller's next output.
420   */
421  public double calculate(
422      double measurement, TrapezoidProfile.State goal, TrapezoidProfile.Constraints constraints) {
423    setConstraints(constraints);
424    return calculate(measurement, goal);
425  }
426
427  /**
428   * Reset the previous error and the integral term.
429   *
430   * @param measurement The current measured State of the system.
431   */
432  public void reset(TrapezoidProfile.State measurement) {
433    m_controller.reset();
434    m_setpoint = measurement;
435  }
436
437  /**
438   * Reset the previous error and the integral term.
439   *
440   * @param measuredPosition The current measured position of the system.
441   * @param measuredVelocity The current measured velocity of the system.
442   */
443  public void reset(double measuredPosition, double measuredVelocity) {
444    reset(new TrapezoidProfile.State(measuredPosition, measuredVelocity));
445  }
446
447  /**
448   * Reset the previous error and the integral term.
449   *
450   * @param measuredPosition The current measured position of the system. The velocity is assumed to
451   *     be zero.
452   */
453  public void reset(double measuredPosition) {
454    reset(measuredPosition, 0.0);
455  }
456
457  @Override
458  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
459    table.log("controller", m_controller);
460    table.log("constraints", m_constraints);
461    table.log("goal", getGoal().position);
462  }
463
464  @Override
465  public String getTelemetryType() {
466    return "ProfiledPIDController";
467  }
468
469  @Override
470  public void publishTunable(TunableTable table) {
471    table.publish("controller", m_controller);
472    table.publishValue(
473        "constraints",
474        () -> m_constraints,
475        value -> setConstraints(value),
476        TrapezoidProfile.Constraints.class,
477        TunableConfig.of(TunableOption.GET_ON_CHANGE));
478    table.publishDouble(
479        "goal",
480        () -> m_goal.position,
481        this::setGoal,
482        TunableConfig.of(TunableOption.GET_ON_CHANGE));
483  }
484
485  @Override
486  public String getTunableType() {
487    return "ProfiledPIDController";
488  }
489}
